correctness.rationale: For L=5,6 the face predicate (distinct selected sources and targets, no directed cycle) is equivalent to components being directed paths. A fresh enumerator built from actual vertex arcs reproduced 80 and 196 nonempty faces, f-vectors (10,30,30,10) and (12,48,76,48,12), and the record pivot-order matching 38 and 96 pairs. All 190 and 576 Hasse incidences were directed and fully topologically sorted, leaving critical cells 0,2,3,3 and 0,2,4,4. For the pentagon, exact Q boundary ranks (21,8) and two disjoint coherently oriented integral top cycles imply zero cellular differential Z²→Z, so the S² attaching maps are degree-zero and null in pi2(S²). For the hexagon, the specified 8-term integral 2-cochain is closed on all 48 tetrahedra and evaluates 1 on a signed octahedral cycle; this makes its H² class primitive. Its Alexander–Whitney square vanishes on every one of the 12 four-simplices. The classical Hopf-invariant/cup-square identity for 4-cells over S² forces both pi3(S²) attaching maps to vanish, proving S²∨2S⁴. For comparison the older Oct.18 seven-term cochain was independently checked closed, nonzero mod-two cohomology (rank 37→38) and zero integral square. This exhaustive finite verification supplies all nonstandard finite certificate premises; only these two graph lengths are claimed.
residual_risks: All homotopy conclusions invoke standard discrete-Morse CW equivalence and classical Hopf-invariant characterizations; the finite checks are exhaustive only for the two stated graphs.
No inference for arbitrary bidirected polygon lengths or equivariant homotopy types is made.
